stem.text: One way of recovering tin from old printed circuit boards is to dissolve it in a mixture of concentrated hydrochloric acid and concentrated nitric acid. The tin dissolves because it reacts with the mixture of these concentrated acids.
Which statements about this reaction are correct?

items: Nitrogen is present in three different oxidation states in the reactants and products.
The oxidation state of tin increases from 0 to +4.
The oxidation state of chlorine remains the same.
